evidence.name: Screen field: Restore link styling
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Restore link styling" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Restore link styling
sections.description: Sets the font, size, weight, color, and alignment of the footer 'Restore Purchases' link. Style it to match the Terms and Privacy links beside it so the legal row reads as one consistent group — small and muted, but still legible. Don't make it look like your main button.
